description_en: Removes tags from Anti-DDoS Origin instances
description_zh: 移除指定资源（DDoS原生防护实例）的标签
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-v0h1fmwbc024 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the instances reside
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instances. Default value: No
parameters.help_zh: 是否移除实例上的所有标签。默认否
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances. Valid values of N: 0 to 49. You can specify up to 50 instances at a time. Example: ResourceId.0, ResourceId.1, ... , ResourceId.49
parameters.help_zh: 要操作的原生防护实例的ID。n的取值范围为 [0, 49]，用于指定多个实例，最多50个。例如：ResourceId.0，ResourceId.1，...，ResourceId.49
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The keys of the tag that you want to remove. Valid values of N: 0 to 19. You can specify up to 20 tag keys at a time. Example: Tag.0.Key, Tag.1.Key, ... , Tag.19.Key
parameters.help_zh: 要移除的标签键。n的取值范围为 [0, 19]，用于指定多个标签键，最多20个。例如：Tag.0.Key，Tag.1.Key，...，Tag.19.Key
parameters.name: tag_key
